speaker.name: Reliability Ruth

output.objection: You are proposing to automate the validation layer while keeping our manual ingestion process, but you have not acknowledged that this leaves a single point of failure in the pipeline. We need you to explicitly state that we are accepting this risk trade off before we agree to the new scope.
output.correction: I did not say the manual ingestion was acceptable because it was easy, I said it was acceptable only if the validation step became fully automated and strict. You filed this as a preference for low effort work, but it is actually a hard requirement for data integrity.
